purpose: Systematically analyse source PDFs, map knowledge to the correct CSP11 Domain, Competency, Topic and Subtopic, generate content and questions, apply quality gates, and import only approved material into the exam platform.
architecture_rule: PDFs -> Source Index -> CSP11 Mapping -> Human Review -> Extraction -> Content -> Questions -> Quality Gate -> Repository
authority_rule: Naveed/Admin remains the final authority over source classification, CSP11 mapping and approval of uncertain material.

phases.title: Source Library Setup
substeps: L1.2 Record book title, edition, publisher and year
L1.3 Assign a unique source ID to every PDF
L1.4 Extract table of contents and chapter structure
L1.5 Extract searchable text from each PDF
L1.6 Identify page ranges for each chapter/section
L1.7 Create a source metadata index
phases.checkpoint: All PDFs are indexed and traceable to page numbers.

phases.title: CSP11 Blueprint Mapping
substeps: L2.1 Load the official 7-domain CSP11 structure
L2.4 Create the master CSP11 mapping table
L2.5 Assign every source section to one or more CSP11 locations
L2.6 Identify source material that does not clearly map
phases.checkpoint: Every CSP11 area has a defined destination.

phases.title: Source-to-Domain Analysis
substeps: L3.2 Identify concepts, principles and terminology
L3.8 Assign confidence to each mapping
L3.9 Flag content requiring human review
phases.checkpoint: A defensible source-to-CSP11 map exists before content creation.

phases.title: Coverage and Gap Detection
substeps: L4.1 Calculate source coverage for each domain
L4.2 Calculate coverage for each competency
L4.4 Identify CSP11 areas with insufficient source material
L4.5 Identify source material with no destination
L4.6 Detect duplicate concepts across domains
L4.7 Flag important CSP11 areas supported by multiple sources
L4.8 Produce a Domain Coverage Report
phases.checkpoint: Coverage, missing material, duplication and uncertainty are identified.

phases.title: Content Extraction
substeps: L5.6 Capture tables and important data
L5.9 Link every extracted item back to its source page
phases.checkpoint: Raw knowledge is organised under the correct CSP11 location.

phases.title: CSP11 Content Generation
substeps: L6.1 Convert extracted material into CSP11 learning content
L6.7 Create tables and comparison material
L6.9 Create exam traps and memory aids
L6.10 Attach references to relevant content
phases.checkpoint: Structured CSP11 content packages are created.

phases.title: Question Generation
substeps: L7.7 Identify the single BEST answer
phases.checkpoint: Questions enter the existing Studio Question Bank lifecycle.

phases.title: Cross-Domain Integrity
substeps: L8.9 Produce exceptions requiring Admin review
phases.checkpoint: No content is silently accepted into the wrong CSP11 location.

phases.title: Admin Review Workflow
substeps: L9.5 Allow Admin to approve/reject mappings
L9.6 Allow Admin to move incorrectly mapped content
phases.checkpoint: Naveed/Admin becomes the final authority over classification.

phases.title: Import into Content Repository
substeps: L10.1 Convert approved content into CSP11 JSON
phases.checkpoint: Approved source-derived material becomes official CSP11 platform content.

phases.title: Final CSP11 Coverage Audit
phases.checkpoint: Domain is considered complete only when it passes the coverage gate.

phases.title: Repeatable Production Pipeline
substeps: L12.8 Freeze the complete CSP11 knowledge base
phases.checkpoint: The complete CSP11 knowledge pipeline is repeatable and passes whole-system integrity review.
